audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Vayne, Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Vayne, Skill, Vayne — giving Vayne levels 2, 3 and 6 outright, which neither the mirror nor the kit supports.
audit.why: The mirror audit (kled__vayne) settled Levels 2, 3 and 4-5 to Kled and Level 6 to Skill. That matches the kits: from level 2 Kled has Bear Trap on a Rope at 800 range plus Jousting at 550 and Violent Tendencies, against Vayne's 550 Condemn on a 20s rank-1 cooldown. Level 6 is genuinely contested because Final Hour answers Chaaaaaaaarge!!!.
audit.corrected: phases[1..3].side and win[1..3] set to Kled; phases[4].side and win[4] set to Skill. All four rows proposed as one atomic group of matched full/content pairs, with the whys[] rewritten to agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and mid described Chaaaaaaaarge!!! as 'repeated all-in threat' with no cooldown and no mention of the shield it grants.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 falling to 110s at rank 3 — far too long to be 'repeatable' — and it arrives with a shield, which is the reason a burst window spent into it is wasted. Bear Trap is 11s at rank 1 to 7s at rank 5; Jousting 13s to 9s; Violent Tendencies 13s to 9s.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and the shield now in spikes[0], spikes[1], early, mid, whys[3], whys[4] and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentioned that both champions carry displacement, that Jousting is recastable, or that Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Condemn (E) and Bear Trap on a Rope (Q) are both displacement — whoever lands theirs first owns the trade, which turns the whole lane into a race rather than a kiting pattern. Jousting can be recast to dash back through the initial target, so surviving the first dash does not mean he is out of range. Violent Tendencies gives massive attack speed for four attacks, so the wind-up is the step-back cue, not a visible cast.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now states the displacement race; early carries the Jousting recast and the Violent Tendencies wind-up tell; breakdown.cooldowns lists both.

edits.before: Level 2 is a skill matchup: it hinges on dodging his Bear Trap.
edits.after: Level 2 favours Kled: Bear Trap on a Rope pulls you into his burst.

edits.before: Level 3 is a skill matchup: landing or dodging Q decides who wins the trade.
edits.after: Level 3 favours Kled: Jousting closes 550 and Violent Tendencies shreds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a skill matchup: his Violent Tendencies burst trades with your kiting.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 favour Kled: a 9s Violent Tendencies out-trades your kite windows.

edits.before: Level 6 favours Kled: his ult and Skaarl remount give repeatable all-in pressure.
edits.after: Level 6 is a skill matchup: Final Hour answers his 140s Chaaaaaaaarge!!! engage.

edits.before: Kled's Bear Trap (Q) pull and Violent Tendencies burst make trades a skill check: dodge the Q and you kite him, eat it and he all-ins.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is an 800-range hook on 11s at rank 1: eat it and you are yanked into Jousting plus Violent Tendencies.

edits.before: Kled's Chaaaaaarge! ult and remounting on Skaarl give repeated all-in threat; his re-engage burst tips the trade his way.
edits.after: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and arrives with a shield — force the shield out before you spend Final Hour on him.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours: before Kled has Bear Trap leveled he cannot pull you and you poke him freely. From 2-5 it becomes a skill check: if he lands Q he pulls himself in and Violent Tendencies shreds, but if you dodge it you kite and stack Silver Bolts on him. Respect his courage-based aggression but do not panic: a whiffed Bear Trap leaves him committed and killable. Space with Tumble and Condemn him when he dashes.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours: before Kled has Bear Trap on a Rope he cannot pull you and you poke him freely. From 2 to 5 he takes over: Q hooks from 800 on an 11s cooldown, Jousting closes 550 and can be recast back through you, and Violent Tendencies is a 9-13s attack-speed burst whose wind-up — not its cast — is your cue to step away. Space with Tumble and hold Condemn for his arrival.

edits.before: Level 6 tips toward Kled: Chaaaaaarge! gives him a long-range engage and, more importantly, remounting Skaarl refreshes his all-in, so a single good trade can snowball. Track his mount health: when he is dismounted he is far squishier and you punish hard. Do not over-extend when his ult is up and his jungler is near. Save Condemn for his gap-close, not his poke.
edits.after: Level 6 is closer than it looks: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140s at rank 1 and comes with a shield, so make him spend that shield before you commit Final Hour. Remounting Skaarl refreshes his all-in, so track his mount health — dismounted he is far squishier. Save Condemn for Jousting's arrival, not his poke, and never fight into a fresh mount.

edits.before: Dodge Bear Trap so he cannot gap-close
edits.after: Condemn him before Bear Trap lands

edits.before: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Dodge or condemn it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope: matchup-defining — 800 range, 11s at rank 1; it yanks you in, so pre-empt it. - Jousting: 13s, 550 range, recastable back through you. - Chaaaaaaaarge!!!: 140s, with a shield. - Condemn: 20s at rank 1.

notes: report[8].t says 'Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern'. Kled has no heal in his kit; the passive restores Skaarl's health through courage gained by fighting, which is not the same thing and I cannot confirm from Riot's text that Grievous Wounds reduces it. Left the line alone and flagging it rather than asserting either way. Full-layer boilerplate calls Vayne 'he/him' (tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, dontsFull, report[3]); dontsFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d are mismatched to their titles — both champion-wide defects. Mirror's summary did not state rows 0, 5 and 6, so I left those untouched to avoid introducing a disagreement.
